description: Edit name, description or labels, archive/restore, or change the composition of an existing audience. Also supports adding/removing included or excluded segments. set_logic must be "union" or "intersection" — never "exclusion". To exclude records, use add_excluded_segment_id. Requires 'creator' scope.

add_excluded_segment_id.description: Segment ID to add as an exclusion — records matching this segment are subtracted from the audience

add_segment_id.description: Segment ID to append to the included list

audience_id.description: The audience ID returned by create_audience or list_audiences

description.description: Human description; null clears it without changing membership

labels.description: Descriptive labels; an empty array clears them

name.description: New display name for the audience

remove_excluded_segment_id.description: Excluded segment ID to stop excluding

remove_segment_id.description: Segment ID to remove from the included list

status.description: Status transition: active once ready, archived to hide from the default list; active restores it

name: patch_audience

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Patch Audience
